newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on US currency trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on US currency trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its American counterpart on Saturday, reflecting the strength of the U.S. dollar overseas, dealers said.
The local dollar ended at T$27.494, against Tuesday's T$27.491 close. Turnover was a slow US$48 million. The market was closed between Wednesday to Friday for New Year holidays.
Dealers said they expected slight upward pressure on the Taiwan dollar to rise as year-end U.S. dollar demand finished.
"But overall, we do not expect any sharp movement," said one dealer. For next week, a T$27.48-27.51 range was seen. -- James Peng (5080815)
